_comment: Online acceptance of a proposal. Linked only from proposals made with the Proposals tool once counsel has reviewed the standard terms; not indexed and not in the sitemap.

metaDescription.en: Accept a Metanoia Advisory proposal online with its reference.
metaDescription.id: Terima proposal Metanoia Advisory secara daring dengan nomornya.

lede.en: Use the reference on the cover of the proposal. The proposal's terms say that confirming acceptance in writing accepts it: this form is that confirmation. We confirm receipt by email.
lede.id: Gunakan nomor yang tercantum di sampul proposal. Ketentuan proposal menyatakan bahwa konfirmasi penerimaan secara tertulis berarti menerimanya: formulir ini adalah konfirmasi tersebut. Kami mengonfirmasi penerimaannya melalui email.

authorised.en: I am authorised to accept this proposal on behalf of the company.
authorised.id: Saya berwenang menerima proposal ini atas nama perusahaan.

accept.en: We accept the proposal with this reference, including its fee and terms of engagement.
accept.id: Kami menerima proposal dengan nomor ini, termasuk biaya dan ketentuan penugasannya.

errAuthorised.en: Please confirm you are authorised to accept.
errAuthorised.id: Mohon konfirmasi bahwa Anda berwenang menerima.

success.en: We have your acceptance. We will confirm by email and send the first invoice as the payment schedule sets out.
success.id: Penerimaan Anda sudah kami terima. Kami akan mengonfirmasi melalui email dan mengirim tagihan pertama sesuai jadwal pembayaran.
